observations: Forward Studio output contains strong isolated rounded or filled responses, including near the lower crop boundary; these do not form a coherent sequence of strokes or text line.
Weak angular and hook-shaped responses in the upper half are diffuse and insufficient to select a follow-up glyph candidate.
Reverse input produces weaker diffuse responses and isolated blobs, without a selected coherent glyph or line.
Reader and Hecate same-XY comparisons do not establish independent confirmation: their depth input and normalization differ, and shared responses may reflect common image structure.
decision: Close model-comparison work on this fixed PHerc0800 window under the predeclared ROI-zero rule. Select a new evidence-backed intervention rather than additional same-window model or depth sweeps.
limits: This is not evidence that the entire scroll or even this window contains no ink.
A high model response is not a calibrated probability of ancient ink.
PHerc0800 native slice orientation relative to model-facing surface normal remains unverified; both orders of the same fixed 16 slices were tested, without selecting an orientation post hoc.
No overall model accuracy ranking, new discovery, or external validation is claimed.
